Python, JavaScript and TypeScript come from 'strong coding proficiency (Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or similar)' under REQUIREMENTS, so they are required.
I mapped 'agent-based systems' to agents. It is a reasonable but not exact alias match.
I did not add ai-deployment for 'deployed or integrated LLM ... in production settings', because the text does not name model deployment as a skill.
MCP integrations, DeepWiki and Devin appear only in the responsibilities or company description, so they are not labeled.
I did not label software-engineering. '3+ years as a software engineer' describes a role and a years count, and 'strong coding proficiency' is generic.
Seniority is mid from '3+ years'. 'Lead interactive programs' is a responsibility to run workshops, not team lead or mentoring duty, so it is not a senior signal. Flagged for review.
Degree: 'or equivalent hands-on experience' accepts experience in place of the degree, so degree_or_equivalent is true. No level is named, so it is bachelor.
